rubric: A bug in the board (a panic in the Rust TUI's PR view), with steps, actual and expected behaviour: ready for an agent. Frontend work (the TUI), extra small or small: one function and its test. Urgency this cycle: a crash someone hits, not whenever and not now. Isolated Rust with a test: low risk. It is real work or a real question: not a duplicate, not stale, so the archive suggestion is no.

criteria.kind: Something that works, or should work, is broken
criteria.ready: Does the issue have testable acceptance criteria an agent could verify without asking anyone?
criteria.size: A line or two: a typo, a constant, a copy change | One function or one file, with its test
criteria.risk_prelim: Isolated code with tests, docs or copy
criteria.archive: Should this be archived instead of worked: a duplicate, out of scope, stale, or nothing an agent can act on?

reading.why: A crash with steps, actual and expected behaviour in the Rust TUI: a bug in frontend code, one function and its test, a crash someone hits this cycle, isolated code with a test, real work to do.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: feature
ruledOut.why: The issue is a crash of something that should work. It is not: New behaviour a user or the pipeline can see.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: task
ruledOut.why: The issue is a crash of something that should work. It is not: A defined piece of work with no new behaviour to design: a migration, a rename, a config change.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: chore
ruledOut.why: The issue is a crash of something that should work. It is not: Upkeep with no new behaviour: a refactor, dependencies, docs, CI.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: question
ruledOut.why: The issue is a crash of something that should work. It is not: It asks for an answer or a decision, not a change.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: incident
ruledOut.why: The issue is a crash of something that should work. It is not: Production is down or wrong right now, data is lost, or a secret is exposed.

ruledOut.question: type_of_work
ruledOut.label: backend
ruledOut.why: It is the terminal UI. It is not: Services, APIs, stages, persistence, adapters.

ruledOut.question: type_of_work
ruledOut.label: infra
ruledOut.why: It is the terminal UI. It is not: Deploys, CI, containers, cloud or runtime configuration.

ruledOut.question: type_of_work
ruledOut.label: data
ruledOut.why: It is the terminal UI. It is not: Schemas, migrations, backfills, pipelines, analytics.

ruledOut.question: type_of_work
ruledOut.label: docs
ruledOut.why: It is the terminal UI. It is not: Documentation or copy only.

ruledOut.question: type_of_work
ruledOut.label: mixed
ruledOut.why: It is the terminal UI. It is not: Two or more of the above in one change.

ruledOut.question: risk_prelim
ruledOut.label: medium
ruledOut.why: It is isolated Rust with a test. It is not: Shared code other features depend on.

ruledOut.question: risk_prelim
ruledOut.label: high
ruledOut.why: It is isolated Rust with a test. It is not: Auth, payments, data migrations, deletion, CI or infrastructure.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: duplicate
ruledOut.why: The ticket is real work. It is not: Another open ticket asks for the same.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: out_of_scope
ruledOut.why: The ticket is real work. It is not: Not this repository's or team's to do.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: stale
ruledOut.why: The ticket is real work. It is not: Overtaken by events; nobody needs it now.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: not_actionable
ruledOut.why: The ticket is real work. It is not: No change an agent could make or verify.
